title: Event Management
enterPassword: Enter your password to access the admin panel
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this player?
researchDayDesc: Choose which day is used for research assignments (Tuesday or Friday).
showFireCrystalsDesc: When enabled, fire crystal input fields are shown on the player submission form and admin tables.
timeSlotSchemeDesc: Choose how minister time slots are generated for the schedule.
schemeExactDesc: Slots align to the hour — 00:00, 00:30 … 23:30 (48 slots per day).
schemeMaxDesc: Begin at 23:50 the night before to fit an extra slot — 23:50, 00:20, 00:50 … (49 slots per day).
sharedSlotNote: Shared slot — same real time as {{day}}. Changes sync across both days.
dragToAssign: Drag players to assign them to time slots
dragTip: Drag players from time slots to the unassigned area to remove them from the schedule.
stateNumberDesc: Set the state number displayed on the home page welcome message.
closingTimeDesc: Set a deadline for new applications. Existing players can still update after this time.
closingTimeZone: Enter the time in {{zone}} time (the timezone chosen with the clock at the top).
noClosingTime: No closing time set (applications always open)
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
deleteApplicationNote: This removes the application from this round, with its assignments. The player profile is kept.

round.label: Round
round.startWarning: This closes "{{round}}" ({{n}} applications). Nothing is deleted: it stays viewable as a past round. Players then start a new application and can copy their last answers.
round.startFirst: This opens the first round, so players can start applying.
round.startError: Failed to start a new round
round.name: Round name
round.readOnly: This is a past round. It is read-only.
round.noRoundsYet: No rounds yet. Click "Start new round" to open applications.
round.alreadyOpen: Another round is already open. Close it first.
round.settingsDesc: These settings apply only to this round. A new round starts with a copy of them.
round.publishedDaysDesc: Players see the schedule of published days on the minister page.
round.remapped: Slot scheme changed. {{n}} assignments moved to the new slots.

tapMove.picked: Moving {{name}}: tap "Move here" on a time slot (or Unassigned).
tapMove.tip: On a phone: tap the move icon on a player, then "Move here" on a slot. A long press also starts a drag.

addPlayer.title: Add a player
addPlayer.desc: Create a sign-up for someone who didn't sign up themselves. Only the player ID and the in-game name are needed; fill in what you know.
addPlayer.known: Known player: details filled in from their profile.
addPlayer.newPlayer: New player: enter their in-game name.
addPlayer.optionalHint: Optional: leave blank what you don't know. The player can complete it later with their player ID.
addPlayer.exists: This player already has a sign-up in this round. Edit that one instead.

heroes.title: Hero library
heroes.desc: The heroes planners can choose from: everything up to the state's hero generation, plus rare and epic heroes (no generation).
heroes.generationDesc: The newest hero generation your state has. Planners never offer heroes from a later generation. Applies to the whole state.
